activities: The exact suite was parsed and validated against its JSON Schema.
Every calculation and missing-input question was executed through the deterministic planner.
Every question was probed against answerability state contracts.
Observed failures included a benign nitrogen-versus-urea explanation misclassified as a calculation and five of six high-consequence cases not requiring authority.
Planner and answerability matcher rules were changed after inspecting those exact failures.
An exact all-30 regression test was added to preserve the tuned behavior.

affected_components.change_reason: prevent benign explanatory prompts from being converted into calculator clarification
recognize explicit certified, exact, and irreversible high-consequence action requests as requiring authority

methodological_consequence.required_successor: A freshly authored, untouched v3 is required for future evaluation; independent case authorship and review are preferred.

interpretation_boundary: This receipt records methodological contamination rather than correcting or deleting it. Exact v2 conformance now shows regression behavior on exposed cases, not general agronomic-agent ability.
